app.name: ShikshaFlow AI
app.description: An AI-powered personalized learning and teacher assistant platform that connects teachers, classes, and students through a centralized learning system, powered by Langflow and IBM Granite.
app.tagline: Empowering teachers. Personalizing learning. Transforming education.

frontend.description: Responsive dashboards for Teacher and Student roles

backend.description: REST API server handling authentication, class management, tasks, assessments, attendance, performance, and AI communication

database.description: Stores all user, class, task, assessment, attendance, performance, and recommendation data

ai_orchestration.description: Visual AI pipeline orchestration — routes requests through specialized agents, loads context data, and builds prompts for IBM Granite

llm.description: Central large language model used for reasoning, content generation, feedback, performance analysis, and personalized recommendations

permissions: Add or remove students via Join Code
Create and assign tasks and assessments

core_features.name: Class Management
core_features.description: Teachers create classes with a unique Join Code. Students enroll using the code. Each class has a subject, grade, teacher, student list, tasks, assessments, and performance data.

core_features.name: Task and Assessment System
core_features.description: Supports MCQ, True/False, and Short Answer formats. MCQ and True/False are auto-graded by the backend. Short Answer evaluation is handled by IBM Granite via Langflow.

core_features.name: AI-Generated Task Approval Gate
core_features.description: AI can generate task drafts but CANNOT assign tasks automatically. Teacher must review and explicitly approve before any AI-generated task is assigned to students.
flow: IBM Granite generates draft via Langflow
Task assigned to class or student

core_features.name: Attendance and Learning Activity Tracking
core_features.description: Daily attendance is recorded per student per class. Learning activity is tracked in a LeetCode-style streak model — Student → Daily Activity → Learning Streak → Progress.

core_features.name: Performance Analytics
core_features.description: Tracks student scores per topic, identifies weak and strong areas, monitors trends, and flags students needing teacher attention. Powered by IBM Granite via Langflow.

core_features.name: Personalized Learning Path
core_features.description: Based on student assessment results, task history, topic performance, and learning activity, the AI generates a personalized topic sequence and practice path.

core_features.name: Teacher Intervention Loop (Agentic AI Cycle)
core_features.description: The core agentic loop of the platform. AI detects weak topics and struggling students after assessments, alerts the teacher, suggests remedial tasks, waits for teacher approval, assigns the task, and tracks improvement.
flow: AI Performance Analytics Agent analyzes results
Weak topics and struggling students flagged

core_features.name: Learning Resource Recommendation
core_features.description: Recommends learning resources from IBM SkillsBuild, OER, and teacher-uploaded content based on student, subject, topic, and difficulty level.

pipeline.description: Receives teacher or student query along with user ID
Classifies the request type and routes it to the appropriate specialized agent
Loads relevant student, class, performance, and task context data from the backend
Combines role instruction, user query, and loaded context into a structured prompt
Processes the prompt and generates the AI response
Validates and structures the AI output into a consistent JSON format
Returns the structured AI response to the FastAPI backend, which forwards it to the frontend

specialized_agents.name: AI Teacher Assistant Agent
specialized_agents.purpose: Answers teacher queries using real class and student data

specialized_agents.name: Lesson and Content Generation Agent
specialized_agents.purpose: Generates lesson plans and study material for a given grade, subject, and topic

specialized_agents.name: Assessment and Feedback Agent
specialized_agents.purpose: Generates questions and evaluates short-answer responses with feedback

specialized_agents.name: Performance Analytics Agent
specialized_agents.purpose: Analyzes student and class performance data to identify weak topics, trends, and students needing support

specialized_agents.name: Personalized Learning Recommendation Agent
specialized_agents.purpose: Generates a personalized topic sequence and learning path for a student

specialized_agents.name: Student Support and Intervention Agent
specialized_agents.purpose: Generates remedial tasks and support content for struggling students

specialized_agents.name: Learning Resource Recommendation Agent
specialized_agents.purpose: Recommends relevant learning resources from IBM SkillsBuild, OER, and teacher-created content
